race.comment: Tough race with plenty of chances. LANGLO CROSSING (2) created a big impression first up for the new yard when he led throughout to score a sharp 3.5 len Maiden win at Taree. Has further upside from a similar gate and will handle the rise in grade and trip. Go close. TOMMYZACAT (5) unwanted in betting on debut ($21), with a fast finishing victory over 1100m at Armidale. Will appreciate the extra trip and can measure up again. CHAMBER OF SECRETS (11) two runs back have been okay and a win looks imminent. Strong through the line as favourite when fourth over 1300m at Dubbo. Fast tempo suits and expected to go close. TRINITY STATE (12) well supported on debut at the good odds with a commanding on speed win over 1190m at Grafton. Jumps into the stalking role again and has genuine winning claims.
